title: RelicTech: Integrations
summary: Track relic clues with scans, records, missions, maps, and careful storage habits.

blocks.title: Connected Systems
blocks.body: Index can expose relic entries, Wiki can keep safe-use notes, TutorialCore can explain mistakes, and Nexus routes may reward careful relic preparation.

blocks.title: Practical Pairings
blocks.body: Use Index for relic entries, Wiki for safe-use notes, Nexus routes for careful counters, and TutorialCore when repeated misuse needs coaching.

blocks.title: Fallback Play
blocks.body: If linked records are absent, store each relic with notes on trigger, cost, danger, and last test site before using it again.

blocks.title: Fallback Check
blocks.body: If the helper addon is absent, keep the same order by hand and follow the manual checkpoint.
